title: Non-Visual Effects of Road Lighting CCT on Driver's Mood, Alertness, Fatigue and Reaction Time: A Comprehensive Neuroergonomic Evaluation Study
reasoning: The paper focuses on the physiological and psychological effects of Correlated Color Temperature (CCT) in road lighting on drivers' mood, alertness, fatigue, and reaction time. It is a study in human factors and ergonomics, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
